Command.Statement:
with set __XLSlice0 as { [Measures].[ZCLVISNO] } set __XLExistingMembers as NonEmpty( [ZCLPAT_PRG].[ZCLPAT_PRG].[Level 02].allmembers, __XLSlice0)
set __XLExistingRangeMembers as SubSet(__XLExistingMembers, 0, 1000) set __XLNonExistingRangeMembers as Iif(__XLExistingRangeMembers.Count = 1000, {}, SubSet( Except([ZCLPAT_PRG].[ZCLPAT_PRG].[Level 02].allmembers, __XLExistingMembers), iif (0 - __XLExistingMembers.Count < 0, 0, 0 - __XLExistingMembers.Count), 1000 ) ) member [Measures].__XLRelated as Intersect( [ZCLPAT_PRG].[ZCLPAT_PRG].currentmember, __XLExistingRangeMembers ).Count set __XLTargetSet as SubSet(Union(__XLExistingRangeMembers, __XLNonExistingRangeMembers), 0, 1000) member [Measures].__XLPath as Generate( Ascendants([ZCLPAT_PRG].[ZCLPAT_PRG].currentmember), [ZCLPAT_PRG].[ZCLPAT_PRG].currentmember.unique_name, "__XLPSEP")
select { [Measures].__XLPath, [Measures].__XLRelated } on 0, __XLTargetSet on 1 from [ZCLHIER] cell properties value
